en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a quiet street scene. The road, lined with trees and multi-story buildings, curves gently to the left. On the right side, there are several buildings with balconies covered in foliage. One building has a visible sign reading 'Restaurant Hermann Ros...'. Several people, including children and an adult, are standing or walking along the sidewalk. The caption at the bottom reads 'Bad Gottleuba — Königstrasse'.
